posts.name: Mohit Anand
posts.cooked:
First the question shown in the screenshot is not complete. It had the additional condition that every number should have a space after it except the last number of the row. And the said line is not present in the screenshot.

Correction I checked it again and it appears public test cases do check for spaces.

Third why 2 private cases are passed but rest are failed and honestly it bugged me to, but then I reviewed my code and found that i wasn’t adhering to the space condition, so after i fixed it i passed all my private test cases.

To sum it up: The additional space condition was the reason private test cases were not passing at least that’s what I deduced.

posts.name: Rajat Shenoi
posts.cooked:
24f2004631:

Second regarding the public test cases. I found out during the exam that public test cases don’t care about the space condition but private cases do.

This actually is counterintuitive and shouldn’t have been the case. Formatting should be same for both public and private cases.

posts.name: Rajat Shenoi
posts.cooked:
I request the course team to consider this issue and award marks even for the situation where there was a space at the end of the line.

This is extremely unfair since the format was validated by the public test cases and one would never have assumed that it is a space problem (because if it was, the public test cases would also have failed).

The assumption one would make is that for some n, the output is wrong, so I would need to find that edge case.

@sayan sir, could you consider this?

posts.name: Rishabh Goyal
posts.cooked: Even I faced this issue in the oppe.. although the expected and actual outputs were exactly the same, the public and private test cases were failing with no clue of what’s the issue. It would be great if this issue could be looked into at the earliest.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
If your code is correct, it will pass both public and private test cases. We have re-run your evaluation for each question against both test cases. We have also verified that a correct solution will work for both the test cases. If your code has a space at the end of each line, that will not work, since it was explicitly mentioned in the question.

These are the types of things that are part of the question, to test if you are able to handle manipulating the output. We cannot, in good conscience, lax this constraint.

555 students have correctly solved Qs3, and got 100 marks, showing there is no issues in evaluation from our side. As such, we cannot award concession marks for this question.

posts.name: Rajat Shenoi
posts.cooked: Understood, thank you for the attention to this matter.
